story:
At H4 Roofing & Construction, roofing is more than a service — it is a commitment to protecting homes, businesses, and families throughout Dayton, Ohio and surrounding communities. As a family-owned and operated company with 15 years of industry experience, H4 Roofing & Construction has built a reputation for delivering dependable roofing and exterior improvement solutions backed by quality workmanship, honest communication, and customer-focused service.

H4 Roofing & Construction was founded on simple principles: provide exceptional customer service, deliver quality craftsmanship, and offer fair pricing without compromising results. Every roofing and exterior project is approached with professionalism, integrity, and a commitment to customer satisfaction.

The company is run by co-owners Drew Harper and Trey L. Harper out of an office at 3347 Witherspoon Drive in Dayton. That address matters more than it might seem. Ohio issues no statewide roofing license, and after every Miami Valley hailstorm a wave of out-of-town crews works the neighborhoods door to door — the Dayton Better Business Bureau has publicly warned homeowners about them. We are the opposite of that by design: a local family business you can look up, drive to, and still reach two winters from now.

Our crews are OSHA 10 and OSHA 30 certified, and we hold CertainTeed ShingleMaster credentials along with Better Business Bureau accreditation and an A+ rating. In a trade with no state licensing, those are the credentials an outside organization has to grant — which is exactly why we carry them. Beyond roofing, we handle siding, gutters, concrete, flooring and drywall, so the work that follows a leak does not turn into a hunt for three more contractors.
